title: Content Marketing Executive
description:
Salary: Competitive

Hours: Monday- Friday 9am- 5:00pm

At Grundon, we're looking for a creative, commercially minded Content Marketing Executive to join our eight strong Marketing team based in Colnbrook near Heathrow Airport. This is an opportunity for someone who knows how to turn a good idea into content that gets noticed, gets people talking and delivers results.

By joining Grundon, your contributions will make a real difference as we work together to show the world that there is more to waste than it seems.

This is a hands-on role where you'll take ownership from idea through to delivery, working across everything from websites, blogs and email to social media, sales materials, video and thought leadership. You'll be confident working independently, whilst also being comfortable collaborating in a team environment. We want someone who brings ideas, spots opportunities and thinks for themselves - finding new and better ways to engage our audiences and support our customers.

Commercial awareness is equally important. You will understand that great content isn't just about being creative; it needs to have a purpose, connect with the right people and ultimately support our wider business goals.

No two days will be the same. You'll be juggling multiple projects, working with a variety of people across the business and thinking on your feet. You'll also have a keen eye for detail, ensuring our content is consistent, engaging and recognisably Grundon across every channel.

With SEO, AI and the way people discover information changing rapidly, you'll also have the opportunity to help shape how Grundon's content performs in both traditional and AI-powered search.

If you're a confident content marketer who combines creativity with commercial thinking, enjoys getting stuck in and wants the freedom to bring your own ideas to the table, we'd love to hear from you.
- Benefits
- Pension Scheme
- Life Assurance
- Employee Assistance Programme
- Health Cash Plan
- Discounted Gym Membership
- Cycle to Work Scheme
- Mobile Phone Discounts
- 30 day's annual leave (inclusive of bank holiday)
- Holiday Purchase Scheme
- Refer a Friend Scheme

What will you do
- Own and deliver multi-channel content across websites, blogs, guides, social media, email, newsletters, sales literature, video, and other formats, tailoring content to different audiences and aligning it with Grundon's brand and commercial objectives.
- Lead and develop our content strategy and editorial calendar, managing multiple projects from initial brief and idea generation through to delivery, ensuring content supports wider Marketing and business priorities.
- Create thought leadership and industry content by researching market trends, industry developments, and customer needs, turning complex information into engaging and accessible content that positions Grundon as a trusted industry expert.
- Drive SEO and AI discovery, working closely with the Digital Marketing Executive to optimise content for search engines and AI-powered search and answer platforms. You'll also use AI tools intelligently to research, test, and refine content.
- Support our Commercial team by creating customer-focused content and marketing materials that help generate new business, retain customers, and strengthen relationships. You'll also provide ad-hoc marketing support at customer events.
- Build relationships with subject matter experts across the business, drawing on their knowledge and expertise to develop accurate, relevant, and credible content.
- Collaborate with Design and Multimedia teams to bring content to life through engaging visual and multimedia formats, including video, animation, and infographics

About you
- Minimum of two years of experience in content marketing, campaign management, copywriting, or a related role.
- Proven experience in content creation, strategy, and multi-channel marketing; experience with scriptwriting and video/animation concept development is a plus.
- Exceptional writing and editing skills, with a strong understanding of tone of voice and brand consistency.
- Ability to tailor content effectively to different audiences and channels.
- Knowledge of SEO/AEO best practices, audience segmentation, and engagement strategies.
- Strong project management, organisational, and time management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook, and PowerPoint); familiarity with digital marketing tools such as WordPress is desirable.
- Self-motivated and proactive, with the ability to work independently, make informed decisions, and take ownership.
- Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with a strong focus on the end-user experience.
- Knowledge of, or interest in, the waste management and aggregates sectors is advantageous.

About Grundon

Grundon is the UK's largest family-owned supplier of integrated waste management and environmental services. We offer a whole host of waste collection, treatment and disposal services, all aimed at helping businesses of all shapes and sizes reduce their environmental impact, maximise resources and find value in their waste. Additionally, at Grundon Sand & Gravel we proudly produce and source high-quality aggregates in a responsible and sustainable way.

We take great pride in our heritage and our distinctive approach, which is true to our company values which include:
- To have integrity
- To be caring
- To deliver excellence
- To maintain curiosity

At Grundon, we are dedicated to creating a diverse, equal, and inclusive workplace. We believe great ideas come from everywhere, and we're committed to creating an environment where everyone feels valued, heard, and empowered to thrive.

If you're ready to take the next step in your career within waste management, this is your opportunity to join us.

title: Graduate Social Media & Content Executive
description:
We are recruiting on behalf of an ambitious and expanding organisation seeking a Graduate Social Media & Content Executive.

This is an excellent opportunity for a recent graduate with a degree in Fashion, Creative Arts, Design, Marketing, Media, Communications, or a related field who is passionate about social media, content creation, and luxury brands.

You will play a key role in building our online presence, creating engaging content, connecting with our audience, and helping showcase our jewellery collections across digital platforms.

Benefits:
- 25 days holiday + bank holidays
- Company pension
- Staff discount scheme
- Hybrid working
- Free onsite parking

As the Social Media & Content Executive, you will be responsible for:

Social Media Management
- Support the day-to-day management of our social media channels, including Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, Pinterest, LinkedIn, and YouTube.
- Assist with planning, scheduling, and publishing content in line with the marketing calendar.
- Monitor social media channels and engage with followers through comments, messages, and customer enquiries.
- Stay up to date with emerging social media trends, features, and best practices.

Content Creation
- Create engaging content including posts, reels, stories, videos, and graphics that showcase our jewellery collections and brand story.
- Assist with product photography, styling, and video content creation.
- Write creative captions, product descriptions, and promotional content that reflects our brand voice.
- Contribute fresh ideas for campaigns, seasonal promotions, and social media initiatives.

Brand Development
- Help maintain a consistent visual identity and brand image across all digital platforms.
- Support the promotion of new collections, product launches, events, and seasonal campaigns.
- Use storytelling and creative content to strengthen brand awareness and customer engagement.

Influencer & Community Engagement
- Research and identify suitable influencers, creators, and brand ambassadors.
- Assist in coordinating influencer collaborations and partnerships.
- Help build and nurture an engaged online community by interacting with followers and customers.

Analytics & Performance
- Monitor social media performance using platform insights and analytics tools.
- Track engagement, reach, audience growth, and website traffic.
- Assist in preparing reports and identifying opportunities to improve content performance.

Marketing & Advertising Support
- Support the creation and delivery of paid social media campaigns.
- Work closely with the marketing team to optimise campaign performance and audience targeting.
- Contribute ideas to help drive brand awareness, engagement, and sales.

The successful Social Media & Content Executive will have the following related skills / experience:

Essential
- Degree in Fashion, Creative Arts, Graphic Design, Marketing, Digital Marketing, Communications, Media, Photography, or a related discipline.
- Passion for social media, digital content, fashion, jewellery, luxury brands, or lifestyle products.
- Strong creative eye with an understanding of visual storytelling and aesthetics.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
- Confidence using social media platforms including Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, Pinterest, and LinkedIn.
- Basic photography, video editing, or graphic design skills.
- Highly organised with the ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines.

Desirable
- Previous internship, placement year, freelance, university project, or personal brand experience involving social media or content creation.
- Experience using Canva, Adobe Creative Suite, CapCut, Meta Business Suite, TikTok Business, or similar creative tools.
- Understanding of influencer marketing and digital advertising.
- Interest in jewellery, fashion, luxury retail, or e-commerce brands.

What We're Looking For
- A creative thinker with a strong visual sense and attention to detail.
- Someone who is passionate about trends, content creation, and social media.
- A proactive individual who enjoys learning and bringing new ideas to the team.
- Strong teamwork and collaboration skills.
- A positive, customer-focused attitude with a willingness to grow and develop within the role.

title: Marketing & Graphic Design Executive
description:
Marketing & Graphic Design Executive
Location: Slough, Berkshire
Employment: Full-time, office-based
About the Role
We're working with a growing and ambitious UK product-led brand that is looking to strengthen its in-house marketing and creative function.
This is a fantastic opportunity for a hands-on Marketing & Graphic Design Executive who enjoys combining creativity with practical marketing and who wants genuine ownership of the work they produce.
You'll play a key role in how the brand is presented across its website, marketing materials, product literature, advertising and customer communications. Working closely with management, sales and product teams, you'll be involved in a wide variety of projects - from creating brochures and promotional campaigns to updating website content and producing technical product documentation.
This would suit someone who enjoys doing the creative work themselves, rather than simply managing external agencies.
What You'll Be Doing
Graphic Design & Creative
- Design and produce brochures, flyers, advertisements, promotional literature and other marketing materials
- Create artwork for billboards, large-format advertising and outdoor campaigns
- Produce digital advertising and promotional graphics
- Create point-of-sale materials and showroom displays
- Maintain consistency across the brand's visual identity
- Prepare print-ready artwork and liaise with external suppliers
- Adapt and resize creative for different formats and platforms

Website & Digital
- Manage day-to-day website content and updates
- Upload new products, ranges, finishes and product information
- Update product descriptions, specifications, imagery and downloadable documents
- Ensure online product information remains accurate, current and professionally presented
- Liaise with external web developers where required

Product & Technical Literature
- Create and update technical specification sheets
- Produce dimensional drawings and technical product information
- Create downloadable PDF technical documents
- Update literature when products or specifications change
- Work closely with product and technical teams to ensure accuracy
- Maintain an organised library of marketing assets, technical documents and imagery
- Produce product launch sheets and sales support materials

Brochures, Catalogues & Imagery
- Assist with the production of major brochures and product catalogues
- Update product codes, descriptions, specifications, pricing and imagery
- Liaise with printers, photographers and other suppliers
- Proof artwork prior to production
- Produce targeted brochures for different product categories and markets
- Coordinate product photography and prepare imagery for web and print

General Marketing
- Support new product and range launches
- Create customer email campaigns and marketing communications
- Produce sales presentations and supporting materials
- Support marketing campaigns across retail, specification and contract markets
- Liaise with external agencies and suppliers when required
- Support exhibitions, showroom events and customer marketing activity
- Bring new ideas to the table to increase brand awareness

What We're Looking For
We're looking for someone with a strong mix of graphic design ability, marketing experience and attention to detail.
You'll ideally have:
- Strong graphic design skills
- Excellent working knowledge of Adobe InDesign, Illustrator and Photoshop
- Experience creating print-ready artwork
- Experience updating and managing website content
- Experience producing brochures, catalogues or technical literature
- Good knowledge of image editing and preparation for web and print
- Exceptional attention to detail, particularly with product codes, measurements and technical information
- Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple projects
- Excellent written English and communication skills
- The ability to work independently and take ownership of projects from brief through to completion

Why This Opportunity?
This is a genuinely varied role where no two days are likely to be the same.
You could be creating a technical specification sheet one day, updating new products on the website the next, preparing billboard artwork, amending a brochure or developing marketing materials for the sales team.
It's an opportunity to join an ambitious and growing business where you'll have real ownership and visibility, working across everything from product launches and technical literature to websites, brochures and advertising campaigns.
If you're a creative, commercially minded and organised marketer who enjoys being hands-on and seeing your ideas come to life, we'd love to hear from you.
